skill.name: obsidian-vault
skill.description: Search, create, and manage notes in the Obsidian vault with wikilinks and index notes. Use when user wants to find, create, or organize notes in Obsidian.
skill.summary: Helps agents search, create, and link notes in an Obsidian vault.
skill.author: mattpocock

content.value_statement: Obsidian vaults become hard to search and connect as notes grow. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to find notes, create linked notes, and maintain index notes.
actual_capabilities: Finds Markdown notes by filename in the configured vault.
Searches note content for keywords in Markdown files.
Creates new notes using title case naming guidance.
Adds Obsidian wikilinks to connect related notes.
Finds backlinks by searching for wikilink references.
Finds index notes by matching index filenames.
limitations: Assumes the vault path is /mnt/d/Obsidian Vault/AI Research/.
Does not install or configure Obsidian plugins.
Does not provide sync, backup, or conflict resolution.
Requires filesystem access to the target vault.

use_cases.title: Build Topic Indexes
use_cases.description: Find related notes and create index notes that group a topic with wikilinks.

use_cases.title: Connect Draft Notes
use_cases.description: Add links between draft notes so ideas remain connected across the vault.

use_cases.title: Find Technical References
use_cases.description: Search notes for a keyword, concept, or backlink before starting new work.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Note
prompt_templates.prompt: Search my Obsidian vault for notes about RAG and summarize the likely matches.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Linked Note
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a new title case note about evaluation loops and add wikilinks to related notes you find.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Index Note
prompt_templates.prompt: Find notes about TypeScript performance and update or create a TypeScript Performance Index note.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Related Notes
prompt_templates.prompt: Review notes about AI agents, identify missing backlinks, and propose index notes before making changes.

output_examples.output: A short list of matching note titles, likely related notes, and the strongest existing backlinks.

output_examples.input: Create a note about retrieval evaluation.
output_examples.output: A title case note with focused content and wikilinks to related evaluation, RAG, and testing notes.
An index note that lists related skill notes as Obsidian wikilinks.

best_practices: Confirm the target vault path before searching or editing notes.
Use title case filenames for every new note.
Add wikilinks only when the related note is relevant.
anti_patterns: Do not create folders when an index note is sufficient.
Do not overwrite existing notes without reviewing their content.
Do not add broad links that do not help future navigation.

faq.question: What vault does this skill use?
faq.answer: It assumes the Obsidian vault path shown in the skill instructions.

faq.question: Can it create new notes?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide creation of title case Markdown notes with related wikilinks.

faq.question: Can it find backlinks?
faq.answer: Yes. It searches for Obsidian wikilink references to locate backlinks.

faq.question: Does it organize notes into folders?
faq.answer: No. The skill favors flat storage, wikilinks, and index notes.

faq.question: Does it require Obsidian to be open?
faq.answer: No. It works with Markdown files in the vault path.

faq.question: Can it manage backups or sync?
faq.answer: No. Backup, sync, and conflict handling are outside this skill.
